# 2007 Elections

There were 3 elections held in Jersey in 2007.

- **[St Peter Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2007#e38)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[St Saviour Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2007#e39)**

  1 seat · Uncontested
- **[Grouville Connétable Election](https://flow.je/elections/2007#e8)**

  1 seat · 2 candidates · 53.2% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

* * *

* * *

## 2007 St Peter Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Peter](https://flow.je/elections/st-peter) (1 seat), 2nd July 2007.

**[Tom du Feu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-du-feu) was elected as Connétable of St Peter in 2007 unopposed**.

#### Sources

- [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jersey\_constable\_election,\_2007](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jersey_constable_election,_2007)

* * *

## 2007 St Saviour Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [St Saviour](https://flow.je/elections/st-saviour) (1 seat), 24th July 2007.

**[Peter Hanning](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-hanning) was elected as Connétable of St Saviour in 2007 unopposed**.

#### Sources

- [https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2007/07/25/st-saviour-constable-elected-unopposed/](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2007/07/25/st-saviour-constable-elected-unopposed/)

* * *

## 2007 Grouville Connétable Election

Election for the role of Connétable of [Grouville](https://flow.je/elections/grouville) (1 seat), 25th July 2007.

**[Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy) was elected as Connétable of Grouville in 2007**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Dan Murphy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/dan-murphy)** |  | 1,040 | 61.9% |
| 2 | [John Le Maistre](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-maistre) |  | 641 | 38.1% |

1,681 votes

3,160 registered voters

53.2% turnout

_Registered voters estimated._
